Subject: Re: Redwood inference demo — scheduling

Hi Irene,

Thank you again for the demo proposal and for the time you and the team have invested. I wanted to let you know we had an exec sync this morning and leadership has decided to push the integration work for new AI features to after our Q4 launch. The decision is driven by resource constraints — the product team is fully focused on the launch, and our CTO is traveling through most of September.

Because of that, we need to pause upcoming vendor demos, including the Redwood inference walkthrough we had penciled in. Can we put our scheduled demo on hold for now and plan to revisit once we’re through the launch window (roughly 6–8 weeks)?

We'd still like to keep the conversation open — please keep us on your waitlist and send any short one-pagers or ROI bullets we can share internally while we’re heads-down. I attached the latest internal roadmap excerpt so you can see the launch scope.

Apologies for the back-and-forth; this is a timing issue rather than lack of interest.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Product, Stowell Systems
M: 415-555-0199

We can absolutely pause the demo and hold your spot. Two small asks while you’re in launch cadence:

- Would it be helpful if I send a 1-page ROI summary and an internal-facing note the GTM team can use? I can include cost/latency tradeoffs and a one-slide migration checklist.
- If you like, we can pencil two short check-in windows (30 minutes) the week of 2025-10-06 and the week of 2025-10-20; you can pick whichever feels right after launch.

If either works, I’ll add a tentative hold on our side and tag the HubSpot deal as "on hold — prospect launch". No pressure — we’ll only activate when you say so.

I’m attaching a concise one-pager that often helps during internal prioritization conversations.

If anything changes earlier, please ping me. Good luck with the launch.

— Irene
